parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use the correct product or quotient rule - M1; at least three of four terms correct. Obtain $\frac{dy}{dx}=-5e^{-5x}\tan^2x+2e^{-5x}\tan x\sec^2x$ - A1 OE. Equate the derivative to zero, use $\sec^2x=1+\tan^2x$ and obtain an equation in $\tan x$ - M1. Obtain $2\tan^2x-5\tan x+2=0$ - A1; allow $2\tan^3x-5\tan^2x+2\tan x=0$. State $x=0$ - B1 from a correct derivative. Solve a three-term quadratic in $\tan x$ and obtain a value of $x$ - M1; must be in radians. Obtain an answer, e.g. $0.464$ - A1; must be 3 d.p. as specified. Obtain the second non-zero answer, e.g. $1.107$, and no other in the given interval - A1; allow A1A0 if both values are given to 2 d.p. or more than 3 d.p. Alternative method: use the correct product or quotient rule - M1; at least three of four terms correct. Obtain $\frac{dy}{dx}=-5e^{-5x}\tan^2x+2e^{-5x}\tan x\sec^2x$ - A1 OE. Equate the derivative to zero and obtain an equation in $\sin x$ and $\cos x$ - M1. Obtain $5\cos x\sin x=2$ - A1; or a simplified equivalent, i.e. cancelled. State $x=0$ - B1 from a correct derivative. Use a double-angle formula or square both sides and solve for $x$ - M1; or an equivalent method; must be in radians. Obtain an answer, e.g. $0.464$ - A1; must be 3 d.p. as specified. Obtain the second non-zero answer, e.g. $1.107$, and no other in the given interval - A1; allow A1A0 if both values are given to 2 d.p. or more than 3 d.p. Total: 8.
